title: People in the US: how are you celebrating Thanksgiving this year amid rising costs in the US?

People in the US: how are you celebrating Thanksgiving this year amid rising costs in the US?
Are you hosting or attending the holiday differently than years past? What are you cutting back on?
Thanksgiving is fast approaching, when people traditionally get together to celebrate with family and friends on this US federal holiday.
Many Americans who usually host the holiday say they are pulling back this year, given the rising costs of food, drinks and housewares.
We would like to speak to Americans about how they are celebrating Thanksgiving this year. Are you celebrating it as normal or skipping it? If you are celebrating, how are you dealing with the rising costs involved with either hosting or attending? What are you cutting back on or changing?
